accepted_lean_inputs.scope: For a prime p, a nonprincipal multiplicative character of F_p extended by zero, and a polynomial f of degree d>=1 with d distinct zeros in an algebraic closure, the norm of sum_{z in F_p} psi(f(z)) is at most (d-1)*sqrt(p). No condition p not dividing d is imposed.
accepted_lean_inputs.expected_type:
∀ (p : ℕ) [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] (ψ : MulChar (ZMod p) ℂ),
  ψ ≠ 1 →
    ∀ (f : Polynomial (ZMod p)),
      0 < f.natDegree →
        Fintype.card ↑(f.rootSet (AlgebraicClosure (ZMod p))) = f.natDegree →
          ‖∑ z, ψ (Polynomial.eval z f)‖ ≤ (↑f.natDegree - 1) * √↑p

accepted_lean_inputs.scope: For prime p, nonzero homogeneous F,G in four variables over F_p of positive degrees m,n, assume the coefficient extension of F to the algebraic closure is irreducible and satisfies the nonvanishing-gradient condition, and the extended pair F,G satisfies the actual rank-two condition at every nonzero common geometric zero. For a nonprincipal multiplicative character psi with psi^n principal and any integer polynomial c satisfying coeff_j((1+m*T)*c)=coeff_j((1+T)^4) for j<=2, there exist r:Nat and lambda:Fin r->Complex such that (r:Int)=m*coeff_2(c*(1-n*T+n^2*T^2)), the actual projective hypersurface character sum equals sum lambda, and every lambda has norm p. This combines Katz spectral data with the general hypersurface adjunction and degree formulas; it contains no quadric specialization or scalar trace bound.
accepted_lean_inputs.expected_type:
∀ (p : ℕ) [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)]
  (F G : MvPolynomial (Fin 4) (ZMod p)) (m n : ℕ),
  0 < m →
    0 < n →
      F.IsHomogeneous m →
        F ≠ 0 →
          G.IsHomogeneous n →
            G ≠ 0 →
              Irreducible ((MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap (ZMod p) (AlgebraicClosure (ZMod p)))) F) →
                QuaternaryQuadraticForms.ProjectiveHypersurfaceSmooth
                    ((MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap (ZMod p) (AlgebraicClosure (ZMod p)))) F) →
                  QuaternaryQuadraticForms.ProjectiveIntersectionTransverseRank
                      ((MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap (ZMod p) (AlgebraicClosure (ZMod p)))) F)
                      ((MvPolynomial.map (algebraMap (ZMod p) (AlgebraicClosure (ZMod p)))) G) →
                    ∀ (ψ : MulChar (ZMod p) ℂ),
                      ψ ≠ 1 →
                        ψ ^ n = 1 →
                          ∀ (c : Polynomial ℤ),
                            QuaternaryQuadraticForms.SurfaceChernRelation m c →
                              ∃ r eigenvalues,
                                ↑r = QuaternaryQuadraticForms.surfaceSectionEulerCoefficient m n c ∧
                                  QuaternaryQuadraticForms.projectiveHypersurfaceTrace F ψ G = ∑ i, eigenvalues i ∧
                                    ∀ (i : Fin r), ‖eigenvalues i‖ = ↑p
